Team / Acme,

We are on track for the private deployment activation window: 2026-10-16 02:00 UTC (maintenance window starts 01:30 UTC). This thread is the authoritative pre-bridge checklist and who-owns-what for the activation bridge. Please read the runbook (attached) and confirm owners below by EOD your local time.

Key goals for the bridge:
- Execute ordered network ACL updates and BGP adjustments for the customer VPC peer.
- Run the smoke validation suite (critical flows only) and gather KPIs (latency, 95th P50, error rate).
- Validate KV cache warmup and prefix caching for the top 10 customer prompts.
- Hold a 90-minute post-activation observation window and handback.

Who I need from Redwood on the bridge:
- Canaries & routing: Rishi (SRE) - own ingress/egress verification and BGP failover testing.
- Network ops & ACLs: Vivek - coordinate cloud partner and firewall rules.
- Observability/alerts: Hannah - ensure alert thresholds and runbook triggers are scoped and visible.
- Customer success liaisons & commercial signoff: Monica.
- Leadership point-of-contact for escalations: Lauren.

Attachments (stubs): redwood_vpc_runbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 210 KB) — runbook includes rollback steps, play-by-play bridge script.

Bridge details:
- Zoom bridge: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=activationbridge
- Slack channel: #cutover-acmehealth (invite sent)
- Postmortem: placeholder scheduled for 2026-10-20 1600 UTC

Please reply in-thread with your confirmation and any missing pieces. If you need any additional test accounts or temporary access to Acme's staging peering, note that here; I will request it from InfraOps.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 03:30:00 +0000
Subject: Bridge wrap: activation complete — brief validation and next steps

Quick bridge readout: activation window executed at 02:00 UTC; we followed the runbook step-for-step. High-level status below.

Smoke validation results (summary):
- End-to-end generation (canonical prompt set): 98% success / 2% transient timeout; median latency 210ms, p95 490ms.
- Function-calling path: all 5 instrumented flows succeeded.
- KV cache warmup: hit-rate 84% after warmers (expected ~80–90%).
- Observability: traces and spans matched expected patterns; two low-severity alerts fired during warmup and were suppressed as planned.

Incident during window: at 02:12 UTC we saw an intermittent routing flap on one egress path to the EdgeCloud partner. Rishi ran the immediate fallback to the secondary path; Vivek coordinated a quick BGP withdraw/announce with Acme which stabilized in 90s. No customer requests were lost; we recorded the event as INVEST-2026-10-16-01 in our event log.

Attachments: smoke_results_20261016.csv (CSV, 22 KB) — contains per-check pass/fail and timings.

Next steps (short list):
- Postmortem playbook assignment: Rishi (owner) — full writeup due 2026-10-19.
- Stability observation: 48-hour watchlist for any regression on p95 latency; Hannah to keep alerting for any repeat flaps.
- Customer follow-up: Monica to confirm commercial acceptance and any immediate billing adjustments.

Thanks to everyone for a clean execution. I'll convert the runbook to a release-tagged copy (v2.1) with the routing flap note and attach it to the postmortem.

— Aditya Rao
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
